title: Anchorpoint begins HKDAP Beta Access rollout
description: Anchorpoint began limited institutional Beta Access for HKDAP, with issuance and redemption available to eligible participants under the issuer's current onboarding and compliance requirements.
notes: This records the operational Beta Access start without inferring broader full-launch retail availability.

title: MoneyGram launches MGUSD on Stellar
description: MoneyGram launched MGUSD as a native U.S.-dollar stablecoin in the U.S. market, identifying Bridge as the regulated issuer, M0 as mint/burn smart-contract infrastructure and Stellar as the launch blockchain.
notes: Primary MoneyGram launch announcement establishes identity, launch date, issuer role and launch network without establishing reserve composition or direct issuer-redemption terms.
